name: secure-credential-bridge
description: Run locally approved SSH commands and configured email/PostgreSQL operations without returning credentials to the model.

interface.shortDescription: Controlled SSH, email, and PostgreSQL access.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP bridge for user-supplied SSH commands approved one at a time, reviewed email drafts, and parameterized read-only PostgreSQL queries. Credentials are resolved locally and never returned by tools.
defaultPrompt: Run an SSH command after local approval
Run a named read-only database query
